title: Optimal geometric inequalities and fully nonlinear conformal flows
summary: We establish sharp Sobolev-type geometric inequalities on $\mathbb{S}^n$ involving the total $σ_k$-curvatures $\int_{\mathbb{S}^n}σ_k(g)\,dv_g$. These results extend the optimal inequalities of Guan--Wang~\cite{GWDuke} from the cone $\mathcal{C}_k$ to the strictly larger cone $\mathcal{C}_{k-1}$, thereby enlarging the range of admissible conformal metrics. Our approach is variational and is implemented through a fully nonlinear conformal flow.
